title: Riyad al-Salihin
author: al-nawawi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Nawawi's selection of reports on intention, repentance, patience, truthfulness, trust in God, the duties of the tongue, the family, neighbours, travel and the remembrance of God. The chapters are short and practical, and the collection became one of the most widely read hadith books in everyday devotional life.
historicalContext: Compiled in Damascus in the thirteenth century for readers who wanted the Prophet's guidance on conduct rather than the full legal corpus. Its combination of short chapters, Qur'anic verses and well-known reports made it a standard text in mosques and homes across the Sunni world.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
